description: RealmeLink Plus by RaFaeLL0 — version 0.3.29. Morphe patches for realme Link 5.8.811.2814: AMOLED dark theme, bypass session expiry (original hxreborn patches); remember ANC/Transparency/Off, remember Game Mode, clean home screen, and experimental single tap. Source: https://github.com/Rafaello0/RealmeLink-Plus

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the light theme with a pure black dark theme. Requires Android 13 or later.

patches.name: Bypass session expiry
patches.description: Stops the session-expired prompt and, when present, the token-invalid toast.

patches.name: Clean home screen
patches.description: Hides the AI/promotional banner and the Virtual Experience title and demo devices on the realme Link home screen. Real connected devices remain visible.

patches.name: Remember game mode
patches.description: Stores manually selected Game Mode on/off and restores it when realme Link reconnects to the earbuds.

patches.name: Remember noise control mode
patches.description: Stores manually selected ANC/Transparency/Off and restores it when realme Link reconnects to the earbuds.

release_notes: RealmeLink Plus v0.3.29 by RaFaeLL0. Six Morphe patches for realme Link 5.8.811.2814, including two preserved GPL-3.0-only patches from hxreborn. Import with Morphe Sources. This build has automated compilation and packaging tests; physical-device testing is separate.
